description: String default type does not cascade to alias, causing numeric coercion of leading-zero strings

provenance.notes: Historical bug: default type (typeof default[arg]==='string') was added to opts[string] only for the base key k, not cascading to its alias array. Fixed by pushing both k and each alias entry into opts[name] when opts[name] exists. Blobs: buggy 3a9e1c6 -> fixed 25fbf07, lib/index.js alias loop.
